create_backend_class: create a Backend subclass that overrides register to expose methods via a function registry
test_truncate_reply: test truncate_reply returns the shortest prefix before any stop sequence in the reply
review_backend_register: review the Backend.register method for registering methods under a name prefix in a registry
summarize_truncate_reply: summarize truncate_reply which splits a reply at each stop sequence and returns the shortest prefix
build_backend_instance: build a Backend instance with a custom _default_name for method registration prefixing
